name: Rewards
overview: Scripture reveals that God rewards both earthly faithfulness and eternal obedience, as believers are called to serve Him wholeheartedly rather than men. Earthly rewards come from delighting in the Lord and faithfully stewarding what He has entrusted to us, while ultimate rewards await in heaven when Christ returns to reward each according to their works. The believer’s perseverance in faith and love for God leads to the crown of life, emphasizing that God is a rewarder of those who diligently seek Him.
